notes: My guest on today's show is Tracy Britt Cool, co-founder of Kanbrick, a long-term investment partnership that provides owners of family-owned, midsized businesses with a differentiated option from traditional private equity. Tracy launched the business after spending ten years at Berkshire Hathaway as one of Warren Buffett's few deputies. She started out of business school as a financial assistant to Buffett, served as Chair of several Berkshire portfolio companies, and later became CEO of Pampered Chef. Our conversation covers Tracy's journey, including lessons from Buffett and the value of operating experience. We turn to the application of those lessons at Kanbrick across its strategy, sourcing, deal dynamics, operational improvements, and long-term holding periods, all supported by the firm's creation of a community of 4,000 executives who share best practices in hiring, operations, excellence, and growth.  Building a Berkshire for the Middle Market – Tracy Britt Cool (EP.521) Oct 19, 2026

 My guest on today's show is Tracy Britt Cool, co-founder of
Kanbrick, a long-term investment partnership that provides owners
of family-owned, midsized businesses with a differentiated option
from traditional private equity. 
   
   
 Tracy launched the business after spending ten years at
Berkshire Hathaway as one of Warren Buffett's few deputies. She
started out of business school as a financial assistant to Buffett,
served as Chair of several Berkshire portfolio companies, and later
became CEO of Pampered Chef. 
   
   
 Our conversation covers Tracy's journey, including lessons
from Buffett and the value of operating experience. We turn to the
application of those lessons at Kanbrick across its strategy,
sourcing, deal dynamics, operational improvements, and long-term
holding periods, all supported by the firm's creation of a
community of 4,000 executives who share best practices in hiring,
operations, excellence, and growth.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
